notes: «حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي» gives the father bare (relation); the three co-transmitters «جَمِيعاً» form one level.
«عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (ع)» after «عن» is a narrator (owner ruling 2); Amir al-Mu'minin speaks in the words after the chain, so he is the last link (owner ruling 2 and 5).
The blessings and «(رحمه الله)» are excluded.
